Description: This ballot measure would expand an existing prohibition on male athletes participating on female school sports teams, add restrictions on locker rooms and define a person's sex according to what was listed on an original birth certificate.
This ballot measure would prohibit surgeries to alter a minor's sex characteristics in response to the child's perceived gender or sex. It also would prohibit state funding for such surgeries.
This ballot measure would prohibit people with male reproductive systems from participating on female athletic teams at schools.

This ballot measure would prohibit biological males from competing in school sports reserved for females and require students to provide a signed statement from a healthcare provider verifying their biological sex based on reproductive anatomy, genetic makeup or natural testosterone levels.

This proposed amendment to Virginia's constitution would repeal a limitation on marriage to one man and one woman and instead declare that two adults cannot be denied marriage based on sex, gender or race.

This proposed amendment to Vermont's constitution would guarantee equal treatment based on race, ethnicity, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, and national origin.

This proposed amendment to Wisconsin's constitution would prohibit governmental entities, public schools and higher education institutions from discriminating or granting preferential treatment on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity or national origin.
